items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I know Jelly Roll was out in California and I just wondered where he got the inspiration for "King Porter Stamp". I've often wondered but now Porter is dead so I don't know if I'll ever find that out.

ctx.x: And I know Jelly Roll was out in California and I just wondered where he got the inspiration for "King Porter Stamp". I've often wondered but now Porter is dead so I don't know if I'll ever find that out.
